text: つれないので　きが　たってた

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので means 'because' and gives the reason for what follows. つれないので = 'because I can't catch anything'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows a state that keeps going; たってた is the shortened spoken form of たっていた. きが　たってた = 'I was on edge'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: つれる is the 'can' form of つる, to fish, and ない makes it 'not'. つれない = 'can't catch any fish'.
